qualification.details: Assistant Professor (Gastrointestinal) (GI) Surgery: A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 now National Medical Commission Act, 2025. Post-graduate and post-doctoral degrees as mentioned in Part-A of Annexure-II or its equivalent qualifications in the concerned Super-speciality (M.Ch. Surgical Gastro-Enterology 2/3 years courses after M.S. Surgery or M.B.B.S. and 5 years direct course). Atleast 3 years teaching experience as Lecturer/ Registrar/ Demonstrators/ Resident after doing post-graduation in the concerned speciality in any recognised Medical College.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the HPPSC Assistant Professor (Gastrointestinal) (GI) Surgery Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of HPPSC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Assistant Professor (Gastrointestinal) Surgery recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) to select eligible candidates for regular government positions within the state medical institutions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor (Gastrointestinal) Surgery post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy advertised under advertisement number 64/10-2026 for the Assistant Professor (Gastrointestinal) (GI) Surgery position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and pay the required application fee is 15-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognized medical qualification, post-graduate/post-doctoral degree (M.Ch./D.M.) in the concerned super-speciality, and at least 3 years of teaching experience in a recognized medical college.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 01-01-2026. Upper age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, WFF, and PWD candidates of Himachal Pradesh against reserved posts.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee for all candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600.00 for all candidates irrespective of category or gender, which must be paid online via debit card, credit card, UPI, or digital payment modes.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be placed on a regular basis with a salary of Rs. 1,29,700/- per month under Cell-1, Level-30 of the pay structure.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for HPPSC Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The selection process involves candidates being directly called for a Personality Test, irrespective of the number of eligible applicants who apply through the online portal.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the HPPSC Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official HPPSC website, completing the One Time Registration (OTR), filling out the application form, uploading necessary documents, and paying the fee online.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF download link, the online application link, and the official website link in the Important Links section of this article.
